description:
For those curious, here's what I mentioned in the video: https://theinvisiblepyramid.com/

In 2007, just months before his death, filmmaker Aaron Russo gave an extraordinary interview about his private conversations with Nicholas Rockefeller, a member of one of America's most influential families.

According to Russo, their friendship opened doors to a world most people never get to see. He was offered opportunities, connections, and a place among powerful circles. But what he claims to have learned about money, politics, global events, and the future of society left him deeply disturbed.

Nearly two decades later, some of the technologies and systems he described are no longer science fiction.

From the Federal Reserve and powerful institutions to digital identification, a cashless society, and the question of who really holds power, this interview raises questions that feel increasingly relevant today.

title: Nick Rockefeller Told Him the Plan. The Scariest Part Is What's Coming NOW...
